findings_closed.title: Partial RetryAthBurnDue could inflate executed_buyback_count by splitting one failed burn retry into multiple successful burn batches
findings_closed.resolution: RetryAthBurnDue now requires msg.amount == ath_burn_retry_due_atomic, so each failed buyback retry must burn the full due amount in one terminal cycle.

retry_policy.counter_semantics: executed_buyback_count increments once per successful original buyback or full failed-buyback retry terminal cycle
